notes.title: The Trials 2 is Coming
notes.content: [h3][b]I'm excited to announce the release date for THE TRIALS 2![/b] 🎉[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]3/7/2025![/b][/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44999553/5be4300567a538a28877d3cb1d65683a91ecb710.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]The Trials is a mesmerizing puzzle and exloration game that will challenge your mind,[/p][p]this game takes you on an unforgettable journey through an island filled stunning environment.[/p][p]Master the art of teleportation, time manipulation, moving between alternate world to solve intricate puzzles[/p][p]Each step forward unveils new challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="VplQLwWXzI0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p]
